_comment: The four directly coded dimensions of the coding instrument and the non-English test used to exclude conversations from coding. Read through codebook_schema.py.

non_english.note: CJK unified ideographs + extension A + kana + hangul. Used by the D-12 coding-purpose exclusion, so its scope IS the criterion: widening or narrowing it changes what is excluded. Four different patterns existed across four files before this was centralised; they agreed on the 2025 corpus only by luck.

direct_instrument.status: working version for calibration; not reliability validated

hints.Providing material / responding: Supplies material or responds without making a request of their own.
hints.Information retrieval: Asks for existing information, a concept, a definition or a mechanism.
hints.Task automation: Asks the assistant to perform work without a supported student-judgement constraint.
hints.Guided generation: Adds a constraint based on the student's judgement to guide the work.

fields.name: AI delegation
codes: hand-back: asks the student to supply

metadata_flags: Task automation default: constraint origin unclear
direct_instrument.note: Human interaction type selected directly using descriptive names. Topic and both AI axes are multi-select. Historical L0–L3 names are a crosswalk, not numeric scores or new human labels. Null denotes missing/unresolved/unavailable status, not a class.

unknown_constraint_origin_default.flag: Task automation default: constraint origin unclear
